reading_focus: White Beryl natal year animal, sexagenary year, four birth pebbles, family and 101 divinations; printed pp145-149 and177-178

source_notes.paraphrase: The White Beryl assigns outcome predicates to the white/black status of four 'precious pebbles' corresponding respectively to natal year, month, day, and hour. White natal-year king pebble forecasts absence of royal punishment and public/market good fortune; black forecasts punishment. The other three address social trust/status, disputes, and household/material resources.
source_notes.study_warning: These are historically situated ambiguous or context-specific descriptions, not numerically calibrated probabilities. Extract actual derivation of each pebble before runtime use.

source_notes.paraphrase: The twelve year-animal profiles attribute personality and behavior tendencies beyond the individual's year element. Examples include independent/brave/harsh speech and risk-taking for Tiger, fewer social ties and solitude for Hare, and energetic/helpful but restless/little sleep for Horse.
source_notes.study_warning: Shared with broader Chinese year-sign tradition, low specific information per person; negative profiles sometimes culturally harsh and require neutral observable question mapping.

source_notes.paraphrase: The Earth Dragon polarity-male sexagenary year entry attributes alleged deception, indolence and enjoyment of alcohol/adultery, an average lifespan of 55, six obstacles, five or seven children, and substantial material wealth.
source_notes.study_warning: The sexagenary polarity male/female labels are year yin/yang, not automatically the subject's biological sex. 'Average lifespan' is a group claim, not an exact individual death prediction; 5 OR 7 children is nonunique.

source_notes.paraphrase: The Fire Ox polarity-female sexagenary entry gives a proposed average lifespan of 71, eight obstacles, an exact family claim of one son and two daughters, and claims of wealth/property and vision issues.
source_notes.study_warning: Reproductive outcomes are right-censored for living participants; use documented full life histories only under appropriate test design. Eye disease claims are not medical advice.

source_notes.paraphrase: A chart for coincident father/mother ages, log-men and trigrams forecasts fatal/accidental risk or family-line discontinuation for a child with specified sex-conditional combinations. The text gives distinct son and daughter example rows.
source_notes.study_warning: Source predicts severe harm; keep as historical object of scientific evaluation only. Cannot score as self-contained individual's natal chart unless independent parental inputs are provided.

source_notes.paraphrase: A five-coincidence method covers elemental vitality, body, destiny and luck and assesses white/black pebble correlations for five elemental relations; translator reports 101 divinations. Growth-and-decline calculations involve 12 sectors grouped into six favorable/unfavorable pairs with three gradations each, producing outcomes for longevity, kin relations, destitution, illness and more.
source_notes.study_warning: The '101 predictions' is the source's own enumerative claim, not 101 validated cases. Need actual distinct parameter combinations and chart tables read before counting unique independent predicates.
